notes:
Fixes from the last few days in the field.

- Same-name leftover on Dropbox: both files stay — don't delete either until the office says so
- Re-check Dropbox when a finished transfer has Dropbox problems (no card). Resume still asks for the card if copy isn't done
- Discarding a whole transfer now needs the couple name typed in
- Audio cards that aren't okay to format now say why on the row
- Two Mini Recorder USB volumes: you pick which one. You can also check a backup folder without writing to the drive
